questions.question: When King Ben-hadad of Aram surrounded Samaria, what did he tell King Ahab of Israel now belonged to him?

answers.text: Ahab's silver and gold and his family
Ahab's horses and chariots and his land
Ahab's fields and flocks and his cities

questions.question: When Aram's huge army surrounded Samaria, what did the LORD say through a prophet He would do with it?

answers.text: Deliver it into Ahab's hand that very day
Send it back home to Aram
Let it hold the city for a while

questions.question: When a prophet promised King Ahab victory over Aram's army, who did the LORD say He would use to win it?

answers.text: The young officers of the district governors
The elders and the people of the land
A band of prophets of the LORD
